purpose: Machine-readable contract for the seven low-cost Scene vertical slices. An approved case records a reproducible identity and oracle; approval alone does not claim that the Fast Scene Suite was executed or passed.

cases.expectedRoute: author source -> generic compiler -> Program -> GraphExecutor -> effect current -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: Inactive optional texture purpose rejected the whole material before the active Program sampler projection, leaving descriptor 168#effect#169 unified-capability-unavailable.
cases.positiveOracle: The exact genericCompilerArtifact node reaches GPU completion, publication, terminal compositor and next-frame; relative to the paired pre-admission 3024x1964 capture, central-rays ROI x=900..1850/y=380..1250 gains at least 30 mean luminance levels while left-control ROI x=100..800/y=650..1250 changes by less than 1.
cases.negativeOracle: Contract rejection for both exact prepared-source artifacts selects boundedSwift for the same node; it still reaches next-frame and leaves unrelated layers visible.

cases.expectedRoute: typed resource readiness -> variant -> generic Program -> GraphExecutor -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: The mask-present variant first reached Program but failed the host premultiplied color contract; after public alpha attenuation normalization, the texture-absent variant still demanded inactive g_Texture1Resolution from an unbound optional slot.
cases.positiveOracle: Both exact genericCompilerArtifact variants reach GPU completion, publication, terminal compositor and next-frame. In 3024x1964 captures, ROI x=907..1420/y=970..1097 has RGB mean <=1 for the authored mask-present variant and >=250 for the texture-absent variant; their difference is confined to that ROI and control x=0..799/y=900..1149 is identical.
cases.negativeOracle: A bad Metal-source digest produces artifact-contract-rejected for the exact generic-only node, skips only that effect through visual-failure-passthrough and publishes its exact previous-current; GPU completion, terminal compositor and next-frame continue. An explicit disable-generic route instead selects shared boundedSwift without restoring any Opacity-specific owner. Existing generation gates still reject pending, stale or mismatched texture publication instead of fabricating a binding.

cases.expectedRoute: graph compiler -> target reservation -> ordered GraphExecutor -> effect current -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: Pass order, target identity, extent, publication, and final ROI match the approved contract.
cases.negativeOracle: A middle-pass failure rolls back only the effect or dependent suffix and keeps unrelated graph branches.

cases.expectedRoute: command graph -> logical pair transition -> publication -> next-frame history consumer
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: Exact logical identity/order and the predeclared two-frame visual sequence are preserved.
cases.negativeOracle: Missing history, stale epoch, or illegal swap fails locally without publishing a false current.

cases.expectedRoute: dependency plan -> external-primary reservation -> typed provider publication -> named Program slot -> GraphExecutor -> compositor
cases.firstBreakpoint: The primary _rt_imageLayerComposite_253_a dependency reached reservation and capture but did not become the exact premultiplied-color Program slot 1, so the ordinary consumer could not execute through GraphExecutor.
cases.positiveOracle: Provider 253 capture and consumer 245 binding conserve effect 245#effect#246, pass 0, slot 1, primary variant, frame epoch, purpose, format, usage and sampling; the Program reaches GPU completion, publication, terminal compositor and next-frame. Relative to the paired secondary-variant negative at 3024x1964, all delta above the registered threshold stays within consumer bbox x=1398..1832/y=1156..1544.
cases.negativeOracle: Changing only the authored reference to _rt_imageLayerComposite_253_b produces typed unsupportedVariant before execution demand, plans no named target, performs zero Program/GraphExecutor execution, and retains 299/299 safe compositor frames. Existing missing, stale, mismatched and cyclic publication gates remain fail-closed.

cases.expectedRoute: per-scene VM -> typed host bridge -> mutation transaction -> next-frame consumer
cases.firstBreakpoint: must be recorded when a fixture is approved
cases.positiveOracle: The exact event order and typed mutation produce the predeclared next-frame ROI or value.
cases.negativeOracle: Exception, timeout, OOM, stale handle, or invalid target terminates only the script owner.
